hero.badge: Property management platform for coliving & multi-room
hero.headline: Managing shared properties is complex. Your data shouldn't be.
hero.subtitle: Centralize contracts, payments, incidents, tasks, and per-unit profitability in a single panel connected to your real data.
hero.noSignup: No public sign-up. Access is provisioned by your property manager.

problems.sectionSubtitle: PropFlow solves them from a single panel connected to your real data.

card1.title: Blind spots in monthly/weekly payments
card1.body: Consolidating income manually creates financial blind spots. You don't know in real time which room is current and which isn't.

card2.title: Hidden turnover costs
card2.body: Move-outs, cleaning, repairs, fees, and unpaid debt reduce your real margin. These costs are scattered across spreadsheets and emails.

card3.title: Per-property tools hide per-room losses
card3.body: Managers need to know which unit or room is underperforming. A fragmented per-property view hides this.

card4.title: Dispersed operational issues
card4.body: Incidents, tasks, sanctions, and tenant communication need to be connected. Today they live in separate tools.

features.sectionSubtitle: From portfolio overview to tenant incidents — built for the complete property management workflow.
